# A template links to a route of its own package the same way it links to any
# other: {{$.Path.Admin.Dashboard}} in a template of admin holds admin's own URL.

muxt generate
muxt check
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./site

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/m/blog": [{}]
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- admin/dashboard.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard()"}}<a id="self" href="{{$.Path.Admin.Dashboard}}">{{.Result}}</a>{{end}}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- blog/article.gohtml --
{{define "GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
-- site/site_test.go --
package site

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m/admin"
	"example.com/m/blog"
)

func TestOwnPackageLink(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	admin.TemplateRoutes(mux, admin.Server{})
	blog.TemplateRoutes(mux, blog.Server{})

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/admin", nil))
	if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("GET /admin status = %d, want %d", got, http.StatusOK)
	}
	want := `id="self" href="/admin"`
	if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("GET /admin body = %q, want it to contain %q", body, want)
	}
}
